/itineraryStops/0/whyOnRoute.source_en: The strongest choice if it is your first day in Busan and you want the images you came for, in an order that flows without backtracking. Low walking except at Gamcheon, and every stop works in any season.

/itineraryStops/0/description.source_en:
The classic first-visit Busan day, taken from our **Busan Top Attractions Day Tour**. It runs east to west across the city: the cliffside sea temple in the morning, the coastal park and Blue Line Park stretch before lunch, then the quiet of the ⟦G0⟧, the painted hillside of Gamcheon, and Jagalchi's working fish market to finish. 

As a charter, it loses the join-in tour's station-meeting chain, so the same stops fit comfortably with time left over — that spare time usually goes to Gamcheon, which people always want longer at.

/itineraryStops/1/description.source_en:
Taken from our **Small-Group Sea Temple, Sky Capsule & Culture Villages tour** — the photo-led version of a Busan day. The morning stays on the eastern coast: the sea temple, the glass-floored Daritdol observatory over the water at Cheongsapo, and the Sky Capsule ride along the old railway line to Mipo. 

The afternoon crosses to the two painted hill villages, Gamcheon and the smaller, quieter Dakbatgol with its wish-stairs monorail. 

The Sky Capsule ticket is bought on the day and is not part of the charter price — the driver-guide helps with the queue, which is the part that catches people out.

/itineraryStops/2/whyOnRoute.source_en: The right route when Busan is a single day of a longer trip and you would rather see the whole shape of the city than three places properly. Also the best rain-day route: markets, the tower and the arcades are all covered.

/itineraryStops/2/description.source_en:
The densest of the three, taken from our **Busan Cruise Shore Coastal Bus Tour** — built originally to show a whole city inside one ship's port call, which makes it the right shape for anyone who has only one day. 

It runs the sea temple and the ⟦G0⟧ in the morning, then works through old downtown on foot-sized hops: Jagalchi, ⟦G3⟧, ⟦G2⟧, then Gamcheon, the Songdo Cloud Trails skywalk out over the water, Songdo Sky Park on the headland, and ⟦G1⟧ with the Busan Diamond Tower to close. 

Stops here are deliberately short — 20 to 45 minutes each. If your group prefers to linger, take this list and cut it in half.
